text:
tara-cs: Novus onboarding hung on init step. Their QA runs and early user sessions show intermittent 429s on /v1/preflight and /v1/init. They need a quick unblock before tomorrow's feature flag flip.
tara-cs: Example from their device logs:
```
POST https://api.redwood.example.com/v1/preflight
Authorization: Bearer <ephemeral>
X-Client-Version: NovusMobile/2.1.0
Response: 429 {"type":"rate_limit", "retry_after": 4}
```
novus-se: We spin up ~25 ephemeral pods during CI warmup. Each pod does an init which triggers token refresh around the same time. We saw many 401s too when rotation collides.
leo-eng: Likely case: high fanout of preflight + synchronized token refreshes exhausting the tenant bucket fast. Do you have traceroute/IPs and tenant id?
tara-cs: Tenant id = t-novus-11. Traceroute: 34.83.12.45, 35.204.4.10, 198.51.100.22.
ops-bot: anomaly: tenant=t-novus-11 spike at 2026-04-12T08:12:34Z _ concurrent_preflight=26 _ token_rotate_cluster=20s window.
dev-rel: Customer-facing quick steps: 1) reduce CI warmup concurrency -> 3-6, 2) add jitter to token refresh (spread rotations), 3) use SDK edge hint / edge preference so egress hits consistent edge cluster.
leo-eng: For the SDK snippet we can suggest the newer config key we added in v1.1: `edgeHint` and `preflightBatchLimit`. Example: 
```js
Redwood.configure({
  apiKey: '__ephemeral__',
  edgeHint: 'eu-north-1',
  preflightBatchLimit: 2,
  auth: { refreshSpreadMs: 600 }
});
```
novus-se: If we increase ephemeral TTL that helps too? Right now tokens rotate every 10s.
leo-eng: Increasing TTL reduces rotation frequency but has security tradeoffs. Safer is spread + jitter; increase TTL only if ops approves.
infra-ops: Ops options: A) temporary tenant cap bump (preflight cap 10->50) for N hours, B) route the listed IPs to eu-north pool, or C) enable header-based edge routing for preflight requests. Need ticket to proceed.
tara-cs: Novus prefers SDK changes first but wants a contingency ops bump during cutover. They asked for a short playbook we can share.
ops-bot: ticket created: INC-9700  request: temporary preflight cap bump + routing exception for t-novus-11 until 2026-04-13T12:00:00Z. Tagged infra + edge-team.
dev-rel: Also recommend upgrading to rn-mobile-sdk v1.1.0 which contains refreshSpreadMs and defaults preflightBatchLimit=2. The release notes mention safer defaults for CI warmup.
leo-eng: I'll canary a tiny change to allow `X-Edge-Hint` header as authoritative for preflight only (low risk) so misrouted DNS egress won't hit the wrong capacity bucket.
novus-se: We'll apply the SDK snippet and throttle CI warmups to 4 concurrent jobs, then report. Standby for cutover.
infra-ops: INC-9700 approved and cap increase applied. Monitoring enabled for t-novus-11.
tara-cs: Thanks everyone. I'll send the code snippet + playbook to Novus and coordinate a short smoke test before the feature flag flip.
dev-rel: follow-up: I'll add a blurb to the onboarding guide about edgeHint, refreshSpreadMs, and CI warmup best-practices.
